format: traditional McDonald's restaurant (McDonald's owns or leases the land and building; franchisee buys equipment, signs, seating and decor)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a traditional McDonald’s franchise ranges from $1,470,500 to $2,642,000 (see Item 7 for small town oil, small town retail, and Satellite locations). This includes an initial franchise fee of $45,000.00

fee.quote: All franchisees pay a $45,000 lump sum initial franchise fee on the opening of the restaurant, except for: (a) the McOpCo companies, which do not pay any initial franchise fee;
fee.note: Prorated fee if real estate tenure or agreed term is 10 years or less; rebuild/relocation gets a credit for part of the previous fee; Satellite locations pay $500 (Walmart locations none) plus a $500 to $2,500 annual fee; STO and STR locations pay $22,500. Fee refunded in full if construction is not completed within 1 year of signing.

royalty.quote: Royalty (1) 5% or 4% of Gross Sales, depending on the circumstances (2) Payable monthly on the 10th day of the next month.

adFund.quote: Advertising and Promotion (5) Not less than 4% of Gross Sales Spent during each calendar year.
adFund.note: Minimum 4% of Gross Sales, not payable to McDonald's; spent through franchisee cooperatives. National fund OPNAD: 'currently 2.00% of sales'; each local cooperative sets its own rate. Rates may or may not exceed the required 4%.

otherRecurring.amount: Varies; Base Rent payable on the 1st day of the month; Percentage Rent payable monthly on the 10th day of the next month

rentToFranchisor: McDonald’s acquires real estate and building and franchises the right to operate at the location. Franchisee pays McDonald's a Monthly Base Rent plus a Fixed Percentage Rent of Gross Sales; for new traditional restaurants opened on or after January 1, 2020 the rate is 10.00% (development costs up to $1,550,000) rising 0.25% per step (e.g. 15.00% for $3,210,001 to $3,310,000). Item 7: Percentage Rent 0.00% to 28.00%. Item 19: 'The range of effective rent percentages in 2023 for franchised restaurants was 0.00% to 33.30%.'

item19.quote: The average annual sales volume of domestic traditional franchised McDonald’s restaurants open at least 1 year as of December 31, 2023, was $3,964,000 during 2023. ... The median annual sales volume of domestic traditional franchised McDonald’s restaurants open at least 1 year as of December 31, 2023, was $3,797,000 during 2023.
item19.note: Count is 'approximately 11,972'. Sales figures only. Pro forma operating income (based on 11,362 independent franchisee restaurants) excludes rent, royalty, depreciation and amortization, interest and income taxes; royalties during the period were 4% of Gross Sales.

special: McDonald's is the landlord: besides royalty (5% for new restaurants; 4% for existing franchisees in some cases) and at least 4% advertising, the franchisee pays McDonald's a Monthly Base Rent plus Fixed Percentage Rent of Gross Sales (10.00% and up for new traditional restaurants; effective rent in 2023 ranged 0.00% to 33.30%). Item 7 totals 'do not include percentage rent or royalty'. Optional co-investment (no less than $30,000 per 0.25% quarter) to lower percentage rent, in addition to Item 7. About 20 annual technology fees paid to McDonald's. Of 20 McOpCo sales in 2023, 5 exceeded the high end of the investment range, by up to $2,297,182.
issues: Item 19 and Item 20 data are for 2023 (FDD issued 2024, amended 2025-01-01). toFranchisor computed: $45,000 fee + Base Rent $0 to $313,000 (3 months). Royalty is 5% for new restaurants, 4% for some existing-franchisee cases. No fixed local ad rate.
